purpose: Freeze a structurally independent heading-optional native FGO train smoke/confirmation set after the v2.1 heading hard-gate No-Go and before reading any selected payload member.

truth_policy.policy: Materialize only declared GNSS/IMU/nav/reference members after this freeze. Generate truth-free artifacts and seal their hashes before opening the two declared train truth members once. Fresh validation and all holdouts remain unopened unless every unchanged train gate passes in a later explicit follow-up.

archive_inventory.inspection_method: ZipFile.infolist() central-directory metadata only; selected member contents were not opened for this freeze.

split_inventory.exclusion_basis: Conservative union of the v2 authoritative truth-use inventory, v2 selected train/validation/future-holdout identities, and the v2.1 independent confirmation identities; no prior scored/opened route-device is eligible for this v3 set.
split_inventory.selection_basis: Metadata-only presence of device_gnss.csv, device_imu.csv, route-level brdc.nav, reference RINEX, and ground_truth.csv; route/year/environment separation; both are pixel5 because the heading failure is an initialization observability case, not a device-family ranking. No truth metric or public/private score was used.

evidence: fgo_gnss_imu.m:40-59 loads prior GNSS/IMU state and calls vel2rpy for initialization
fgo_gnss_imu.m:129-143 synchronizes IMU and applies gravity, noise, and RzRyRx mounting parameters
fgo_gnss_imu.m:145-186 inserts Pose3, position, velocity, clock, drift, and zero-bias states
fgo_gnss_imu.m:252-299 adds motion, clock, ordinary TDCP, IMU, and bias factors
functions/vel2rpy.m:5-14 smooths velocity over 20 samples, uses a 0.5 m/s threshold, and fills low-speed headings by nearest value
functions/imuprocessing.m:5-40 maps elapsed-ns sensor times and uses gyro-clock synchronization with coefficient 0.5
upstream_initialization_audit.distinction: The v3 implementation ports only the observable initialization rationale and frozen frame/noise values; it does not copy MATLAB graph code or use truth-derived state. Unlike the upstream nearest-filled yaw, v3 explicitly represents weak yaw with a finite broad prior and a fail-closed fallback.

gravity_leveling.failure_action: fail closed to exact v1 graph

course_initialization.weak_course_action: do not abort; preserve gravity roll/pitch and use broad finite yaw prior

weak_yaw_gauge.nonfinite_or_conditioning_failure_action: disable IMU and run the exact v1 preserve-TDCP/motion graph

frame_and_units.sensor_frame: Android CSV converted to body FLU
frame_and_units.time: GPST seconds in IMU CSV; Unix output subtracts 18 UTC leap seconds

commands.materialize_after_freeze: verify only the declared central metadata, then atomically materialize device_gnss.csv, device_imu.csv, route-level brdc.nav, and reference_obs for the two selected identities; do not materialize ground_truth until after truth-free artifacts are sealed
commands.adapter_truth_free: python3 apps/gnss.py smartphone-gnss-adapter --device-gnss <inputs/device_gnss.csv> --output-dir <adapter> --dataset-id <route/phone> --device-model pixel5 --source-url https://taroz.net/data/dataset_2023.zip --source-terms 'Original GSDC competition terms; local evaluation only' --role development --truth-free --skip-epochs 0 --max-epochs -1 --experimental-galileo-e1 --experimental-galileo-e1-hatch-window-s 30 --broadcast-nav <inputs/brdc.nav>
commands.truth_score_once: after both route truth-free output/detail/summary artifacts and hashes are sealed, materialize/read only the two declared train ground_truth.csv members once; no rerun or parameter change

structural_each_route: gravity or exact-v1 fallback is finite
pseudorange, ordinary TDCP, position/clock motion, and CombinedImu factors are nonzero when IMU path is selected
all forbidden base/single-difference factor counts are zero
solver converges with finite costs, states, covariance initialization, and keyed finite output
no isolated two-sided >70 m/s coordinate spike

truth_scored_each_route_and_aggregate.physical_continuity: finite coordinates and no unexplained >70 m/s isolated two-sided jump

predeclared_train_gate.promotion: Only if every unchanged train route and aggregate gate passes may a fresh validation be opened once in a later explicit follow-up. This record does not authorize validation or holdout access.
